```{r}
library(readr)        # Read/write data
library(survival)     # Cox model and Surv objects
library(survminer)    # ggplot-based survival curves (ggsurvplot)
library(patchwork)    # Combine ggplot objects into composite figures
library(dplyr)        # Data manipulation (filter, mutate, etc.)
library(ggplot2)      # Base plotting system
library(RColorBrewer) # Predefined color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Arrange multiple grid-based plots (grobs)
library(pheatmap)     # Clustered heatmap with annotations
```

```{r}
load("~/data/fig4.RData")  # Load pre-saved R objects: preditos, data, all_clinical_miR
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Kaplan-Meier curve: predicted prognosis groups (Random Forest output) ---

# Cox PH model to test association between predicted class and OS
stats = summary(coxph(Surv(time5, Pred) ~ ClassProg2, data = preditos))

# Kaplan-Meier estimator stratified by model-predicted prognostic group
fit <- survfit(Surv(time5, Pred) ~ ClassProg2, data = preditos)

# Plot KM curves with risk table and log-rank p-value
surv2 = ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  palette = c("#20b2aa", "#DB7093"), # Teal = Good, Pink = Poor
  xlab = "Survival time in years",
  ylab = "Probability of overall survival",
  surv.median.line = c("hv"),        # Horizontal + vertical median survival lines
  cumcensor = F,
  conf.int = F,
  risk.table = TRUE,                 # At-risk table below the plot
  pval = T,                          # Log-rank p-value
  title = 'Prognosis group predicted by the model (RF)',
  risk.table.y.text.col = T,
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
  legend.labs = c("Good", "Poor"),
  font.main = c(10), font.legend = c(10), font.y = c(10),
  font.x = c(10), font.caption = c(10), font.tickslab = c(10),
  fontsize = 3, risk.table.height = 0.3, pval.size = 4, censor.size = 6,
  font.ytickslab = c(10)
)

# Fine-tune title and axis label positioning
surv2$plot = surv2$plot + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.2, size = 9))
surv2$table = surv2$table + theme(
  axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2, size = 9),
  axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2, size = 9),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9)
) + ggtitle("Number of patients at risk")

surv2
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# --- 2. Extract and normalize miRNA expression ---

# Identify miRNA columns by "hsa_mir" prefix convention
miRNA_cols <- grep("^hsa_mir", names(data), value = TRUE)
expr <- data[, miRNA_cols]
rownames(expr) <- data$bcr_patient_barcode  # Use TCGA patient barcodes as row names

# Log2 transform with pseudocount to stabilize variance across samples
expr_scaled <- log2(expr + 1)

# --- 3. Prepare data for Cox risk score computation ---
cox_data <- as.data.frame(expr)
cox_data$time   <- data$time5    # Overall survival time
cox_data$status <- data$status5  # Event indicator (1 = death, 0 = censored)

# --- 4. Fit multivariable Cox model using all selected miRNAs ---
cox_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste(miRNA_cols, collapse = "+")))
cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data = cox_data)

# --- 5. Compute risk score (linear predictor from Cox model) ---
# Higher values indicate higher predicted risk of death
risk_score <- predict(cox_model, type = "lp")
names(risk_score) <- data$bcr_patient_barcode

# Sort samples by ascending risk score for the heatmap ordering
ordered_samples <- names(sort(risk_score))
expr_ordered <- expr_scaled[ordered_samples, , drop = FALSE]  # Rows = samples

# --- 6. Risk score line plot ---
risk_df <- data.frame(Sample = 1:length(risk_score), RiskScore = sort(risk_score))

risk_plot <- ggplot(risk_df, aes(x = Sample, y = RiskScore)) +
  geom_line(color = "#585FD2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Risk score index") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),   # Hide x-axis; aligned with heatmap below
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

# --- 7. Annotated heatmap (pheatmap) ---

# Match clinical annotations to the risk-ordered sample list
all = all_clinical_miR[rownames(expr_ordered), ]

# Build annotation dataframe: one row per sample, columns = clinical variables
annotation_df <- data.frame(
  MUC16_level       = log2(all$MUC16 + 1),                                    # Continuous: log-CA125
  HRD_status        = factor(all$HRD_status),                                  # Categorical: HRD pos/neg
  Age_at_Diagnosis  = ifelse(all$Age_at_Diagnosis >= 50, ">50", "<50")         # Binary age group
)
rownames(annotation_df) <- rownames(expr_ordered)

# Color mappings for each annotation track
ann_colors <- list(
  HRD_status       = c("HRD positive" = "#9E9AC8", "HRD negative" = "#54278F"),
  MUC16_level      = colorRampPalette(c("gray", "#6BAED6", "#08306B"))(100),   # Gray -> dark blue
  Age_at_Diagnosis = c(">50" = "#9E0142", "<50" = "#56B4E9")
)

# Draw heatmap and capture as a grob for later layout with patchwork/gridExtra
heatmap_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr({
  pheatmap(t(expr_ordered),            # Transpose: rows = miRNAs, cols = samples
           cluster_rows = FALSE,       # Preserve miRNA order (no row clustering)
           cluster_cols = FALSE,       # Preserve risk-score sample order
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           show_rownames = TRUE,
           legend_breaks = c(-2, 0, 2),
           scale = 'row',             # Z-score each miRNA across samples
           color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
           fontsize_row = 8,
           annotation_col = annotation_df,   # Clinical tracks above the heatmap
           annotation_colors = ann_colors)
})

# Stack risk plot (top) and heatmap (bottom) with proportional heights
top = grid.arrange(risk_plot, heatmap_grob, heights = c(2, 4))

# --- 8. Multivariate Cox model with prognostic score ---

# Merge risk scores into the clinical table for multivariate analysis
risk_df$bcr_patient_barcode = rownames(risk_df)
names(all)[1] = "bcr_patient_barcode"
all = merge(risk_df, all, by = "bcr_patient_barcode")
names(all)[3] = "Score_prognosis"   # Rename linear predictor column

# Multivariate Cox: clinical covariates + miRNA-based prognostic score
f1 <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time = all$time5, event = all$status5) ~ ",
                       paste(c("Stage", "Age_at_Diagnosis", "MUC16", "Subtype_mRNA",
                               "HRD_status", "Score_prognosis"), collapse = "+")))

fit.coxph <- coxph(f1, data = all)
summary(fit.coxph)   # Print HR, CI, and p-values

# Forest plot of multivariate Cox results
ggforest = ggforest(fit.coxph, data = all,
                    main = "Multivariate analysis  \nUp to 5-year Overall Survival (Score prognosis with 11 miRNAs)")

# --- 9. Assemble final composite figure ---
library(ggplotify)  # Converts grob/grid objects to ggplot for patchwork compatibility
library(patchwork)

# Convert stacked risk+heatmap grob to ggplot object
top_plot <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(top)

# Stack forest plot (top) above the risk score + heatmap panel (bottom)
final_plot <- ggforest / top_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(1.5, 1.2))

print(final_plot)
```
